messages.subject: Internal Error! Cannot start ......
parts:
Any idea what I've missed on the server.   I have a file working locally on rstudio fine.   But on the server, when I dial up the URL I get this error message.  I've copy-pasted the histogram files (ui.R, server.R) on the server in another folder and get the same error.

Thanks
Paul

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: Internal Error! Cannot start ......
parts:
Hi Paul, please make sure that your applications are underneath the ~/ShinyApps directory (it doesn't exist by default, you have to create it). For example, if your application is in a directory named "foo", make sure it's ~/ShinyApps/foo.

LMK if that doesn't solve it...
